question: After dedupe and rules, does quota sampling by the CPU reader find more rare-condition items than random?

method.name: Exact + MinHash dedupe, rules filter, stratified quota sampling with a pre-set random comparison

stop: Dedupe removes more than 30% of the pool: stop and check the shingle setting. Ratio is scored at P6.
risk_first: Run triage on 1,000 items first; check the CPU reader answers and timing.
